[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Set matrix zeroes** [LC 73 · Set Matrix Zeroes](https://leetcode.com/problems/set-matrix-zeroes/){difficulty="Medium"}

Wiping a row the moment you see a zero creates zeros that were not in the input, and reading those later dooms rows and columns that should survive. So **decide first, wipe second**: record which rows and columns must go from the original values, then wipe — and to do it in $O(1)$ space, keep that record in row 0 and column 0 of the matrix itself.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p3-zeroes.]{.card-link}

:::
